By the end of the class, the student will be able to:
•  search the internet accurately and download content;

A single fact: number, word, image, date.

Without context, it has no meaning.

Example: 25, Belgrade, yesterday.

A meaningful whole created by connecting data.

It can be understood and verified.

Example: “Yesterday in Belgrade, it was 25 °C.”

Understanding information and its application.

Based on it, we make decisions.

Example: “It’s warm — I’ll take water and a hat.”
List three pieces of data from today that only make sense together.
